_source: Hand-verified from ASX Appendix 4D + Half-year Financial Report (Mineral Resources Limited, half year ended 31 December 2025, filed 20 February 2026). All values AUD, scale=millions confirmed from '$M' column headers. Revenue verified from Appendix 4D page 1 ('Revenues from ordinary activities = 3,052') and income statement page 14 ('REVENUE = 3,052'). EBIT: 'PROFIT/(LOSS) FROM OPERATIONS = 1,031' (IS row 13, page 14) — before finance costs. np_attributable: 'Equity holders of the parent = 495' (IS row 27, page 14) — excludes 78M NCI. Cash-flow values verified from statement of cash flows page 17. capex: 'Payments for property, plant and equipment = (333)' (CF page 17). cash_end: 'Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the half-year = 638' (CF page 17). Shares outstanding verified from share capital note page 32 ('Balance at 31 December 2025 = 196,478,902' net of treasury shares). net_debt expectation reviewed 2026-04-11: the filing does not state a numeric net debt value explicitly. Borrowings and cash are explicit, but 4,878 is derived from components and is therefore out of scope under the explicit-only extraction contract. Arithmetic cross-check: 412 (start) + 880 (ops) - 527 (investing) - 126 (financing) - 1 (FX) = 638 (cash_end).

notes.net_debt: Gold review completed 2026-04-11. The only parsed table hit for 'Net debt' is a glossary definition on page 50, not a numeric metric row. The filing provides explicit borrowings (369 current + 5,147 non-current) and cash (638), so 4,878 is derivable, but non-5B derivation is not allowed under the explicit-only contract. Expected null.
